policy.reuse: Reference links and authored summaries; no bureau/paid score feed or logo bundled

sources.name: Better Business Bureau
sources.summary: Letter ratings, accreditation, customer stars and complaint resolution are distinct.
sources.limit: No rating or no accreditation is neutral. Reviews do not determine letter grades; ratings are not guarantees.

sources.name: FTC legal cases
sources.summary: Case timelines distinguish complaints, proposed settlements, final orders and refunds.
sources.limit: Record exact named defendant, date and outcome; allegations and warnings are not final findings.

sources.name: Competition Bureau Canada
sources.summary: Official competition and deceptive-marketing enforcement research.
sources.limit: Homepage discovery does not establish a case; match legal subject and final procedural outcome.

sources.name: CBP forced-labor actions
sources.summary: Withhold Release Orders and Findings have distinct evidentiary bases and commodity scopes.
sources.limit: Check active/modified/revoked/superseded status. WROs are not conclusive forced-labor findings.

sources.name: OFAC sanctions search
sources.summary: Official sanctions candidate screening.
sources.limit: Name similarity is not risk probability. Confirm identifiers, program and applicability; no match is not clearance.

sources.name: Consolidated Screening List
sources.summary: Commerce, State and Treasury export-screening records.
sources.limit: Link only: return to original agency. A duplicate OFAC record adds no independent corroboration.

sources.name: GLEIF legal identity
sources.summary: Exact LEI records resolve legal identity and entity status.
sources.limit: Issued/lapsed LEI registration and entity active/inactive are different fields; identity is not good conduct.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.summary: CIK, filings, former names and corporate structure.
sources.limit: A filing or ticker alone does not prove active legal status or ownership of a merchant domain.

sources.name: Corporations Canada
sources.summary: Federal corporation identity discovery.
sources.limit: No federal result does not prove nonregistration; provincial records may be needed.

sources.name: INEGI DENUE
sources.summary: Mexican establishment/location discovery.
sources.limit: Presence is not corporate standing or product-origin certification; API token may be required.

sources.name: PROFECO Buró Comercial
sources.summary: Complaint outcomes and stated reporting-period coverage.
sources.limit: Link only: commercial/advertising reuse restrictions. Absence can reflect confidentiality, partial coverage or capture errors.

sources.name: PROFECO Distintivo Digital
sources.summary: Responsible e-commerce provider roster; Digital Distinction and Code of Ethics are distinct.
sources.limit: Link only pending reuse clearance. Does not establish origin, universal product safety or tariff compliance.

sources.name: PROFECO online-store monitoring
sources.summary: Periodic e-commerce information/consumer-rights monitoring.
sources.limit: Link only: stated results cannot be used by businesses for advertising or commercial purposes.

sources.name: USMCA official guidance
sources.summary: Goods/transaction origin certification with required data elements.
sources.limit: No company-wide USMCA trust certificate. Foreign inputs may qualify; this does not prove entirely regional origin.

sources.name: CBP CROSS rulings
sources.summary: Product-specific origin/classification rulings.
sources.limit: Match model, manufacturing facts, date and current applicability; another product cannot inherit a ruling.

sources.name: EcoVadis
sources.summary: Relative sustainability-management ratings; medals have 12-month validity.
sources.limit: No product certification or endorsement. Exact entity scope and Recognition Page required.
sources.access: public methodology; paid scorecards and sharing terms

sources.name: Sedex / SMETA
sources.summary: Site social audits and corrective-action tracking.
sources.limit: SMETA is not certification or a pass/fail guarantee; approved auditor/site/date/scope matter.
sources.access: public guidance; authorized member access to reports

sources.name: amfori BSCI
sources.summary: Production-site social audits graded A–E with follow-up obligations.
sources.limit: Not certification; full reports restricted to members/audited suppliers. Grades are site/date-specific.

sources.name: B Lab / B Corp directory
sources.summary: Official certified-company discovery lead.
sources.limit: Directory body unreadable in this audit. Recheck exact legal entity/scope/current status; no origin implication.

sources.name: OEKO-TEX label check
sources.summary: Case-sensitive certificate/label lookup and withdrawn-label records.
sources.limit: Match scheme, expiry and article scope. No result needs follow-up, not automatic counterfeit labeling.

sources.name: GOTS
sources.summary: Textile scope and transaction certification research.
sources.limit: Company scope does not prove shipment origin; v8 general mandatory date is March 2027.

sources.name: UL Product iQ
sources.summary: Official product certification discovery.
sources.limit: Model/file/standard scope matters; component recognition is not finished-product certification.
sources.access: official lookup; account/access terms may apply

sources.name: TÜV Rheinland Certipedia
sources.summary: Certificate-number discovery lead.
sources.limit: Retrieval failed; recheck availability and terms before data integration.

sources.name: CPSC recalls
sources.summary: Official recalls and manufacturer/importer aliases.
sources.limit: Exact model/serial/lot and remedial scope required; recall is not proof every item or sister brand is unsafe.

sources.name: Health Canada recalls
sources.summary: Canadian product recall research lead.
sources.limit: Current API/reuse terms remain to be tested; match model/lot/jurisdiction before applying.

sources.name: U.S. federal courts / PACER
sources.summary: Federal dockets and case parties; state courts require separate jurisdiction-specific checks.
sources.limit: PACER can charge for searches, including no matches; opinions are free. No automated purchases.

sources.name: GovInfo court opinions
sources.summary: Free opinions from participating U.S. federal courts.
sources.limit: Opinions are not a complete pending-case docket; confirm subsequent appeal/vacatur.

sources.name: Canada Federal Court files
sources.summary: Party-name, court-file and recorded-history research.
sources.limit: Federal jurisdiction only; provincial courts differ; latest recorded entry may lag.

sources.name: Mexico federal case and decision portals
sources.summary: Court/expediente and public-version decision discovery.
sources.limit: Public versions may redact parties; portals and state courts are separate. Redacted identity must abstain.

sources.name: CourtListener / RECAP discovery
sources.summary: Discover public U.S. opinions and contributed federal dockets; search/docket alerts exist.
sources.limit: Incomplete contribution coverage; authenticated alerts have membership limits. RECAP fetch can buy PACER records. Lead only; verify original court.
sources.access: Link only; public search / account-dependent API

sources.name: CanLII decisions and RSS
sources.summary: Canadian published decisions and bounded RSS discovery.
sources.limit: Decisions do not cover all pending cases; automated/large retrieval requires authorized channels under current terms.
sources.access: Link only; manual public lookup / RSS discovery

sources.name: FMCSA SAFER carrier snapshot
sources.summary: Free exact USDOT/MC/MX carrier lookup, safety rating, inspections and crash summaries.
sources.limit: FMCSA-registered carriers only, including registered Canadian/Mexican carriers. Safety data is not litigation or delivery-quality proof; no rating is neutral. Import/API terms not validated.
